checks.name: linux-book-correctness
command:
set -eu
python -c 'import sys, pyarrow; assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3,11,17); assert pyarrow.__version__ == "15.0.2"'
for mode in optimized sanitized; do
  case "$mode" in
    optimized) flags='-O2' ;;
    sanitized) flags='-O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer' ;;
  esac
  for test in baseline-book level-pool; do
    case "$test" in
      baseline-book) source=/checkout/baselines/native/tests/book_test.cpp ;;
      level-pool) source=/checkout/expirements/20261008-native-hypotheses/h03-level-pool/level_pool_test.cpp ;;
    esac
    g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off $flags \
      -I /checkout/baselines/native "$source" -o "/tmp/$test-$mode"
    "/tmp/$test-$mode"
  done
done
